author: AI-drafted, human-reviewed and approved before model execution.
stability_protocol: Use one fixed main analysis. Three independent identical production representation declarations per selected case. Prefer selected spatial/probability compiler; if unavailable use the planner declaration. These are predeclared stability samples, never semantic retries. Preserve rejection outcomes. Three extra declaration requests after the first-pass pipeline; first-pass request not counted among the three.

scoring.PASS: 核心教材語意正確、representation 合理、固定/可調判斷合理、沒有捏造來源或互動；適用時 runtime 可完成，不適用時能誠實降級。
scoring.PARTIAL: 核心語意大致正確，但 grounding / representation / runtime 有明顯缺口，且不至於誤導學習者。
scoring.FAIL: 核心教材語意錯誤、固定/可調判斷會誤導、捏造公式/來源/affordance，或應可完成的核心流程無法使用。
scoring.NOT_APPLICABLE: 該能力依來源本來就不適用，例如 static case 沒有 direct manipulation。

unsupported_semantics: no gravitational orbit or motor torque model
no changing the original source examples

domain_semantics.angular_velocity: Source-dependent signed or positive. A signed directional angular velocity is distinct from a positive angular-speed magnitude. Names alone do not establish either domain.

approval_provenance: Direct user review of the ten-case table, with six final adjustments. Approval covers freezing expectations; paid API execution remains prohibited in this turn.

A.name: semantic/source correctness
criteria: domain legality according to source meaning
no invented formulas, source facts or justified affordances
A.evidence_requirement: Compare the actual declaration and displayed content against the frozen source expectations and original pages. Validator/compiler acceptance is not semantic correctness evidence.

B.name: engineering/runtime result
criteria: appropriate supported compilation or honest degradation
local interaction request delta and browser behavior
B.evidence_requirement: Use validator/compiler/runtime/browser observations; report missing evidence separately.

assessment_rules: Report A and B independently for every case; never replace A with validator/compile PASS.
NOT_APPLICABLE is source-based capability inapplicability, never a label for work not performed.
A static/formal result can PASS when justified by the source; direct manipulation is not mandatory.
No source-dependent angular-velocity domain guessing by parameter IDs, labels or topic names.
Gold is never sent to the model; frozen expectations are never edited after model execution.
